text: にもつ　いっぱいで　もてないよ

structure.jp: にもつ　いっぱいで

patterns.name: 〜で (reason)
patterns.explanation: で after a describing word joins it to what follows and gives the reason: 'is ... and so'. いっぱいで = 'being full, so'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing もつ to もてる makes it 'can carry'; with ない it is 'cannot'. もてない = 'can't carry'.
